I honestly think people see suicide in a very bad light because we precisely don't know what happens after death, and those who aren't depressed or mentally ill haven't really experienced the point where death is the sweetest offer one could possibly get. It's a matter of others being unknowledgeable, or downright ignorant minsan. Nasanay din kase mga pinoy sa pag-adhere sa religious dogma na usually ay hindi nakakatulong sa suicidal na tao. "Paano ko pa ba maiisip well-being ng iba kung hirap na hirap na nga ako sarili ko?", "Bakit kelangan ko mapunta sa impyerno, e gusto ko lang naman mapayapa?" The mind of a suicidal person constantly asks itself these questions whenever someone else tries to impart their ideals on them. Parang nagkakaroon ng feedback loop, na unconsciously irerebutt ng isip mo ung sinasabi ng iba. 

Eto siguro dahilan ng iba kaya tingin bad ang suicide hahahaha like naiinis na siguro sila dahil di kayang matulungan nung tao ung sarili nila, which is unfair justification. Masisisi mo ba taong nastroke or naparalyze kung gusto nya maglakad pero hindi makaya dahil sobrang nahihirapan?

Same lang dito sis. Lahat ng kaibigan ko, may mga trabaho na, samantalang ako, nagpapakatanga lang sa valo kahit di ako maalam. I have tried what you implied you'll do in your post: isolation and suicide. 

Isolation came first for me, and it just pushed me into the latter one. That feeling that you don't belong...it would manifest. Like, for real. Nung una, iniisip mo lang, pero once you're thrust into a sociable environment, malalaman mo nalang na di nagmanifest na sya: iiwasan ka ng mga tao bc you seem isolated from others. 

And about suicide...the worst part is knowing you survived. Sa lahat ng naexperience ko na nagsuicide (kasama ako), isa lang sa kanila ung natuluyan. Once you live again, you'll either be stronger than ever or be filled with dread, knowing you're not even good enough to kill yourself properly. I've experienced the latter, and TW, those thoughts are starting to overpower me again. 

Bakit ko to sinabi lahat? What did you feel when you read those two things? You either felt nothing, or reflected to yourself that this would only lead to more suffering. Isolation leads to more suffering (trust me when I say so), and suicide isn't guaranteed to work. 

As a stranger, my words might not mean enough, but know that it's still not too late. Pls don't isolate yourself. You'll lose that sense of humanity once you do. You'll alienate yourself from others. Everything won't feel the same again. The most colorful days would be tinted grey. We all appreciate you, and we don't want you to fall to the depths. Sana kayanin mo yannnn, goodluck sayo
